title: Emrys and the Border
author: Mirabel Ashgrove
blurb: Isandro Montrose, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
